specification:
# Fixture program
Create a C++ executable that prints the value supplied by a local header. The output must be fixture. Add a CTest script to check it.

files.content:
#pragma once

inline constexpr const char* status_text() { return "fixture"; }

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.21)
project(Fixture LANGUAGES CXX)
add_executable(status-check main.cpp)
target_compile_features(status-check PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
target_include_directories(status-check PRIVATE include)
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME output COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" "-DAPP=$<TARGET_FILE:status-check>" -P "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tests/check.cmake")

execute_process(COMMAND "${APP}" RESULT_VARIABLE code OUTPUT_VARIABLE output OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE)
if(NOT code STREQUAL "0" OR NOT output STREQUAL "fixture")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Unexpected status output: ${code} ${output}")
endif()
